title: VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification

paragraphs.en: Regression-based RL for flow models mandates sampling without classifier-free guidance (CFG) to align the rectification target with the reference marginal velocity. Extending Advantage-Weighted Rectification (AWR), which dynamically scales this regression target based on reward, to video generation encounters a cold-start pathology: unguided rollouts collapse into low-fidelity regions where intra-group reward gaps remain wide but no longer track perceptual quality, rendering the optimization target arbitrary. Conversely, utilizing guided rollouts to restore fidelity, while keeping the regression target tied to the guided sampling distribution, provably triggers a geometric guidance blow-up under exponential-moving-average (EMA) updates. We propose VideoAWR , which resolves this tension by untying sampling from the optimization anchor. An EMA reference policy generates guided rollouts to restore reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the unguided conditional anchor. We prove this decoupled objective is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation, filtering out the reward-neutral guidance offset and retaining only the reward-correlated covariance increment. Consequently, inference runs single-branch and CFG-free, yet inference-time CFG preserves its original semantics. Furthermore, we introduce Decoupled Timestep Rectification , supervising each rollout at an independently sampled timestep without bias to improve sample efficiency. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B and 14B demonstrate stable optimization and superior visual and motion quality in both CFG-free and CFG-enabled regimes. paragraphs.zh: 基于回归的流模型强化学习必须采用无分类器引导（CFG）的采样方法，以使校正目标与参考边际速度保持一致。 将优势加权校正（AWR）扩展到视频生成领域时，会遇到冷启动问题：无引导的滚动会坍缩到低保真区域，此时组内奖励差距依然很大，但已无法反映感知质量，导致优化目标变得任意。 相反，若利用有引导的滚动来恢复保真度，同时将回归目标与有引导的采样分布绑定，则可在指数移动平均（EMA）更新下引发几何级数的引导放大效应。 我们提出了 VideoAWR，通过解耦采样与优化锚点来解决这一矛盾。 EMA 参考策略生成有引导的滚动以恢复奖励的可区分性，而可训练策略则针对无引导的条件锚点进行校正。 我们证明了这种解耦目标在数学上是精确的：中心化优势在期望上会抵消锚点，从而过滤掉与奖励无关的引导偏移，仅保留与奖励相关的协方差增量。 因此，推理过程为单分支且无需 CFG，但推理时的 CFG 仍保留了其原始语义。 此外，我们引入了解耦时间步校正方法，通过在每个独立采样的时间步上进行监督，避免偏差以提高采样效率。 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 14B 上的实验表明，无论是在无 CFG 还是有 CFG 的情况下，该方法都能实现稳定的优化以及更优的视觉和运动质量。 代码可在 attr/Border [0 0 0] user/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR) >> VideoAWR 获取。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning for generative alignment ( Black et al. 2024 ; Fan et al. 2023 ; Rafailov et al. 2023 ) extends to text-to-video ( Prabhudesai et al. 2024 ; Liu et al. 2024 ; Xing et al. 2024 ) primarily through policy-gradient ( Shao et al. 2024 ; Liu et al. 2026a ; Xue et al. 2025 ) and regression-based methods ( Zheng et al. 2025 ; Fu et al. 2026 ) . The latter embeds the reward directly into the velocity-matching objective ( Peters et al. 2010 ; Peng et al. 2019 ) , bypassing intractable trajectory-likelihood estimation over long rollouts. However, regression dictates strict data collection constraints: the target anchor—the marginal velocity of a reference path ( Lipman et al. 2022 ; Liu et al. 2023 ) —doubles as the sampling field. Because CFG ( Ho and Salimans 2022 ; Dhariwal and Nichol 2021 ) distorts this marginal, rollouts must theoretically remain unguided .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式对齐的强化学习（Black 等，2024；Fan 等，2023；Rafailov 等，2023）主要通过策略梯度方法（Shao 等，2024；Liu 等，2026a；Xue 等，2025）和基于回归的方法（Zheng 等，2025；Fu 等，2026）扩展到文本到视频生成领域（Prabhudesai 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Xing 等，2024）。 后一种方法将奖励直接嵌入速度匹配目标中（Peters 等，2010；Peng 等，2019），从而避免了在长序列生成过程中难以计算的轨迹似然估计。 然而，回归方法要求严格的数据收集约束：目标锚点——即参考路径的边际速度（Lipman 等，2022；Liu 等，2023）——同时充当采样场。 由于 CFG（Ho 和 Salimans，2022；Dhariwal 和 Nichol，2021）会扭曲这一边际分布，理论上生成序列必须保持无引导状态。

paragraphs.en: In video generation, this unguided requirement degrades optimization. Sampled without CFG, models like Wan2.1 ( Wan et al. 2025 ) yield videos confined to a low-fidelity region where reward models ( Wu et al. 2023 ; Ma et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2026b ) lose discriminative capacity (Figure VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification ). The induced intra-group ranking becomes arbitrary, causing initial reward degradation. Conversely, restoring fidelity via guided rollouts ( Guo et al. 2025 ; Frans et al. 2025 ) while anchoring on that same CFG field induces inter-round instability. We prove that under EMA updates, this coupling geometrically compounds the conditional–unconditional gap. Must guided exploration then be paid for with unstable training?
paragraphs.zh: 在视频生成中，这种无引导的要求会劣化优化效果。 若未经 CFG 采样，Wan2.1（Wan 等人，2025）等模型生成的视频会被限制在低保真区域，而在此区域中，奖励模型（Wu 等人，2023；Ma 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2026b）会失去区分能力（图 VideoAWR：通过解耦时间步优势加权校正强化视频流模型）。 由此产生的组内排名变得随意，导致初始奖励的劣化。 相反，通过引导式展开（Guo 等人，2025；Frans 等人，2025）恢复保真度，同时锚定在同一 CFG 场中，则会引发轮次间的稳定性问题。 我们证明，在 EMA 更新下，这种耦合会几何级数地放大条件与无条件之间的差距。 那么，稳定的训练是否必须以牺牲引导式探索为代价？

paragraphs.en: We propose VideoAWR , which explicitly separates the sampling distribution from the optimization anchor . The EMA reference policy generates guided rollouts to maintain fidelity and reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the unguided conditional anchor. Characterizing the population optimum of this decoupled objective demonstrates that the mismatch is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation. This isolates the unguided conditional velocity and the reward-correlated covariance increment, strictly filtering out the guidance offset . Consequently, inference operates via a single forward branch, and the conditional–unconditional gap shifts only by an advantage-bounded increment, preserving inference-time CFG semantics. This structurally contrasts with guidance distillation ( Meng et al. 2023 ; Tang et al. 2025 ) , which forfeits inference-time guidance by baking the field directly into the network.

paragraphs.en: Following the success of RLHF in language and image domains ( Ouyang et al. 2022 ; Black et al. 2024 ; Fan et al. 2023 ) , aligning text-to-video models with human preferences has drawn increasing attention. Direct preference optimization has been extended to video by constructing preference pairs at different granularities ( Liu et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2024 ) . Parallelly, online RL formulations treat video diffusion and flow processes as multi-step Markov decision processes, optimizing reverse-process transitions via policy gradients ( Black et al. 2024 ; Fan et al. 2023 ) . For continuous flow-based video models, Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al. 2026a ) and DanceGRPO ( Xue et al. 2025 ) introduce stochasticity into ODE integration to yield tractable transition probabilities and enable group-relative credit assignment. To mitigate the heavy computational overhead of long spatiotemporal trajectories, recent extensions adopt mixed ODE–SDE sampling or single-timestep trajectory supervision ( Li et al. 2025 ; He et al. 2026 ) . However, these policy-gradient derivatives struggle when the unguided generation quality is severely degraded at cold start.
paragraphs.zh: 继强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）在语言和图像领域取得成功之后（Ouyang 等，2022；Black 等，2024；Fan 等，2023），将文本到视频模型与人类偏好对齐的问题也日益受到关注。 直接偏好优化方法已被扩展至视频领域，通过在不同粒度上构建偏好对来实现（Liu 等，2024；Wu 等，2026；Zhang 等，2024）。 与此同时，在线强化学习框架将视频扩散和流过程视为多步马尔可夫决策过程，并通过策略梯度优化反向过程的转移（Black 等，2024；Fan 等，2023）。 对于基于连续流的视频模型，Flow-GRPO（Liu 等，2026a）和 DanceGRPO（Xue 等，2025）在常微分方程（ODE）积分中引入了随机性，从而获得了可处理的转移概率，并实现了组内相对信用分配。 为缓解长时空轨迹带来的巨大计算开销，近期的扩展方法采用了混合 ODE–SDE 采样或单时间步轨迹监督（Li 等，2025；He 等，2026）。 然而，当冷启动时未引导的生成质量严重下降时，这些策略梯度导数会面临困难。

paragraphs.en: Classifier-free guidance boosts conditional alignment by extrapolating conditional velocity fields away from unconditional ones, at the expense of an additional evaluation branch ( Ho and Salimans 2022 ) ; guidance distillation avoids this overhead by regressing the combined field into a single network ( Meng et al. 2023 ) . For flow-based preference alignment, DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al. 2025 ) models positive and negative transitions on the forward process, while FlowAWR ( Fu et al. 2026 ) anchors advantage-weighted rectification on the reference policy’s velocity field. These methods work for image generation without CFG at sampling time, but in video they meet the cold-start pathology above. VideoAWR instead confines CFG to the sampler.

paragraphs.en: VideoAWR adapts the advantage-weighted rectification paradigm to the alignment of text-to-video flow models, which presents two primary challenges. First, the reference field is structurally mismatched to the reward signal: dropping CFG destroys the reward separability that relative advantage estimation depends on, yet anchoring the target on the amplified CFG field makes training diverge (Sec. 4.1 ). Second, the training timestep must be sampled cheaply and without bias, ideally decoupling the temporal supervision from the terminal reward, allowing optimization via point-wise regression to maximize sample efficiency (Sec. 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: VideoAWR 将优势加权校正范式应用于文本到视频流模型的对齐过程，但这一方法存在两个主要挑战。 首先，参考场与奖励信号在结构上并不匹配：移除 CFG 会破坏相对优势估计所依赖的奖励可分离性，而将目标锚定在放大的 CFG 场上又会导致训练发散（第 4.1 节）。 其次，训练时间步必须能够以低成本且无偏的方式采样，理想情况下应将时间监督与最终奖励解耦，从而通过逐点回归进行优化，以最大化采样效率（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Rewards and Evaluation. We optimize two complementary rewards. paragraphs.en: Guided Rollout. We compare our design against two alternatives with the identical objective but different sampling and anchoring: (i) no-CFG sampling , rolling out without guidance; and (ii) anchor-on-CFG , rolling out with guidance but anchoring the target on the CFG field (Proposition 1 ). paragraphs.en: VideoAWR formulates “guided rollout, unguided training” as behavior-anchored advantage-weighted rectification. By restricting guidance strictly to the sampling phase, the optimized policy isolates the reward-correlated velocity increment and filters out the guidance offset, thereby preventing the geometric divergence associated with CFG-anchored training. Consequently, the fine-tuned model supports both inference regimes: it enables efficient CFG-free single-branch generation while preserving the original semantics of inference-time CFG. Integrated with Decoupled Timestep Rectification, VideoAWR provides a stable online optimization framework that maintains better inference flexibility for both CFG-free and CFG-enabled inference.
paragraphs.zh: VideoAWR 将“引导式展开、无引导训练”表述为以行为为锚点的优势加权修正。 通过将引导严格限制在采样阶段，优化后的策略能够分离出与奖励相关的速度增量并过滤掉引导偏移，从而避免与 CFG 锚定训练相关的几何发散问题。 因此，经过微调的模型支持两种推理模式：它既能实现高效的无 CFG 单分支生成，又能保留推理时 CFG 原有的语义。 VideoAWR 与解耦时间步修正相结合，提供了一个稳定的在线优化框架，在保持无 CFG 和有 CFG 推理模式的同时，均能维持更优的推理灵活性。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 2 mathematically permits arbitrary behavior distributions, establishing that the optimization anchor is invariant to the sampling policy. Currently, VideoAWR solely utilizes CFG-guided rollouts from the EMA backbone. Consequently, optimization is bounded by the base model’s inherent generation capabilities; prompts that the backbone fundamentally fails to render cannot yield informative reward gradients, regardless of the guidance scale. Because anchor invariance supports any behavior distribution, integrating off-policy or out-of-distribution terminals requires no modification to the underlying objective. Investigating this off-policy data integration constitutes a primary direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 2 在数学上允许任意的行为分布，从而确立了优化锚点与采样策略无关。 目前，VideoAWR 仅使用由 EMA 主干模型通过 CFG 引导的 rollout。 因此，优化受限于基础模型固有的生成能力；无论引导尺度如何，主干模型根本无法生成的提示都无法产生有信息量的奖励梯度。 由于锚点不变性支持任何行为分布，因此整合离策略或分布外的终端无需对底层目标函数进行任何修改。 研究这种离策略数据的整合是未来工作的主要方向之一。

paragraphs.en: Anchoring a regression target directly on the guided sampling field provides a straightforward route to CFG-free inference: the conditional branch internalizes the amplified behavior field and can therefore generate strong samples without evaluating an unconditional branch. However, this changes the semantics of the conditional–unconditional gap. Applying CFG again may extrapolate from a conditional field that has already absorbed guidance, effectively amplifying the same offset twice.
paragraphs.zh: 将回归目标直接锚定在引导采样场上，为无需 CFG 的推理提供了一条直接路径：条件分支会内化增强后的行为场，因此无需评估无条件分支即可生成高质量的样本。 然而，这会改变条件与无条件之间的语义差异。 再次应用 CFG 可能会从一个已经吸收了引导信息的条件场中进行外推，从而实际上将相同的偏移量放大了两次。

paragraphs.en: We first examine this effect using the official DiffusionNFT checkpoint ( Zheng et al. 2025 ) . As shown in Table 2 , the released model is strong under CFG-free inference, but enabling CFG decreases every reported Task and DrawBench metric. The largest drops occur on OCR ( 0.90 → 0.69 0.90\rightarrow 0.69 ), HPSv2.1 ( 0.330 → 0.273 0.330\rightarrow 0.273 ), ImageReward ( 1.48 → 1.03 1.48\rightarrow 1.03 ), and the two PickScore evaluations ( 23.36 → 20.99 23.36\rightarrow 20.99 and 23.79 → 22.03 23.79\rightarrow 22.03 ). paragraphs.en: This observation motivates the dual-mode requirement targeted by VideoAWR: guided behavior should improve exploration without being baked into the conditional anchor.
